Kirkbride et al. v. The Kroger Co.

Case No. 2:21-cv-00022

United States District Court for the Southern District of Ohio

Attention

This is the official Settlement Website for the Kirkbride et al. v. The Kroger Co., authorized by the United States District Court for the Southern District of Ohio.

 

  • A proposed Settlement as been reached in a class action lawsuit regarding The Kroger Co.'s ("Kroger") usual and customary ("U&C") pricing practices on behalf of individuals who paid for one or more prescription drugs at Kroger using their insurance.
  • Your legal rights will be affected whether you act or do not act. You should read the entire Notice carefully

Your Legal Rights and Options in This Settlement

To exercise your right to obtain a share of the Net Settlement Fund, you must complete, sign, and submit a Claim Form (and documentation, if required) by December 21, 2026. Claims where the total amount claimed is $8,000 or more require supporting documentation sufficient to identify the individual’s payments to Kroger during the Settlement Class Period.
